findings.finding: Line 9 states as fact that Palimnex 2.10.0 is published on PyPI, and the install examples pin pipx/uv/pip to palimnex[crypto]==2.10.0 and git+...@v2.10.0. Local tags contain only v2.9.0. Owner decision 2026-11-08 reserves tag, GitHub release and PyPI publication for a separate approval. The release-prep brief required replacing install pins, which produced this false publication claim.

The install section tells operators to install the exact published release from PyPI as palimnex[crypto]==2.10.0, or the Git tag v2.10.0. Neither the tag nor a PyPI publication exists. Distribution identity on line 14 (version is 2.10.0) is acceptable for a candidate; the published-release/tag pins are not.

The 2.10.0 paragraph says the release is additive with no existing identifier, reader, CLI command, configuration key, cache, ledger or pack format changes, and it never discloses the retention-migrate --no-snapshot removal. That CLI removal was announced in 2.9.0 and is implemented in this candidate. The owner's parenthetical invariants hold (API v1 migrate_retention(snapshot=False) remains; ledger schema v1 and EVENT_KINDS match v2.9.0; production retrieval stays off by default). The conflict is this compatibility sentence versus the announced CLI removal in the same version.

The 2.9.0 → 2.10.0 section correctly says --no-snapshot is removed and argparse exits 2. Later operator text still treats the flag as live: under In 2.8.0 and later, `--no-snapshot` skips it (line 280); under In 2.9.0 and later, the option is deprecated, prints a warning, adds deprecations, and is removed in 2.10.0 (lines 308-311). A 2.10.0 operator following those sections would invoke a flag argparse now rejects.

NO_SNAPSHOT_DEPRECATION was rewritten to mention the 2.10.0 CLI removal and kept SDK snapshot=False, but nothing in palimnex/ imports it after core.py dropped the CLI path. The live SDK warning remains palimnex/api.py (outside the lane's owned files): migrate_retention() without snapshot=True is deprecated. That text is accurate and still matches the tests; it does not mention the CLI removal the brief asked the SDK warning to state.

The Version 2.10.0 sentence names only the Phase 1 registry foundation. The same paragraph says nothing loads a registry unless a caller passes its path. 2.10.0 explain-search loads ontology/concept-registry.v1.json by default, which the later Phase 2 paragraph already describes. Promoting the old unreleased Phase 1 blurb to Version 2.10.0 makes that path sentence read as a release-wide promise.

Section 2.10.0 - 2026-11-08 preserves every prior Unreleased bullet, adds the announced --no-snapshot removal, and keeps the coordinator placeholder. It covers git log v2.9.0..HEAD product commits (registry, explain-search/coverage, shadow eval, opt-in influence, held semantic shadow, feedback) plus the uncommitted CLI removal. The dated final-release heading is the usual publication-commit form.
Unchanged, as required: remaining 2.9.0 mentions are the implementation/deprecation timeline, not current-version or install pins.

Prep-lane evidence still says the CLI exposes --no-snapshot. That was true before the second lane; the working tree now removes the option. Out-of-scope dirty file docs/ONTOLOGY_ADOPTION.md (closure lane) was used only as the owner-decision source.
